findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: place_phone_call, get_call, answer_call_question, list_calls, get_batch_calls · Private data: place_phone_call, answer_call_question · Public sink: place_phone_call, answer_call_question · Destructive: place_batch_calls.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: place_phone_call, get_call, answer_call_question, list_calls, get_batch_calls · Private data: place_phone_call, answer_call_question · Public sink: place_phone_call, answer_call_question · Destructive: place_batch_calls

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
